Title: Microsoft Cognitive Services | Computer Vision API

Body.Content:
Computer Vision API represents a collection of state-of-the-art image-processing algorithms, designed to return information based on visual content and to help generate suitable thumbnails. A new OCR model for English, with several improvements in terms of accuracy, is available in preview.

Learn More
